book.name: Filibi
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ kentaashɛ ke Filibi

content: Ɛ Baul nya ntefe ɛ̂ bonyii bo mbee le bo Filibi

Nonɛn boom bo bwɛɛm e, me ŋkooŋke ben baay mbvuu ŋkɛŋke shiee keen'yɛn ben e. Ɛ̀ nu ben bò gee ɛ me n'yuuke njoŋ, ɛ ben bvuu nu kefo kem ke bvunfon e. Nsáa yɛm, ben emum eleemè kɛ tɛmyi ben ɛ bo Tata nonɛn.
Me nlɛke lɛ Ɛwodia bô Sintiki emɛɛshɛ fiɛɛ fì bó kɛŋke etu diuw mwaaŋ no bó nu wee bô waa bwee nje Tata.

Me ɛ no ŋgayte tɛn ɛ̂ wo wɛ wvù looci nu naa wee wɛm ŋgoo lɛ wo efi kɛ bokɛnɛ ban ɛ́ bó etu diuw mwaaŋ. Ɛ̀ nu bonyii ɛ bó ɛ katɛn wase bee bó yî lemme di saaka wvù jee wvu ɛkumɛ Jisos Klistu le bô bo Kelɛmɛn noo bonyii bomew bò bee bó to lemte. Bonyii ban bocii nu ɛ ɛdiee ɛbo nu wase ɛ̂ ŋwa' bonyii bò kɛŋke nshii wvù mɛy lo le.
Ben eyuukè njoŋ sekecii no ben nu bonyii bo Tata le. No me ŋgay nu ɛ me mbvuu ŋkaase ntuu fó lɛ ben eyuukè njoŋ.
Ben eduŋcì gee di nyɛkeey ɛ̂ wee tfuu, ekumyì lɛ kefew kè Tata nu ke ekase eto nu wase nceencee.
Fo ben ebuukè naa lo ɛkumɛ fiɛɛ fimew kɛ. Ben ebunleè lo fô fiɛɛ ficii le gɛɛle fwe dvu Nyo'. Ben dioo bunlee no biite mwɛɛm mvù ben shieele ɛ̂ wvú, enyaà keyoone yî mvù wvú gee le.

Ɛ́ ben gee nonɛn, ɛ́ Nyo' emum enya ben nyɛkeey we ɛ́ wvú ecɛyte mvuntelem bô bvufee bvunɛn no ben nu bonyii bo Klistu Jisos e. Nyɛkeey wvun wvù Nyo' nyaa nu ɛ kɛ ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ wee ekiɛɛ kenfewsɛn kedvu kɛ.

Boom bo bwɛɛm e keemɛse, mwɛɛm mvù ben kɛŋke keekpwawcì nu mwɛɛm mvù nu mvu kecɛɛy bô mwɛɛm mvù kɛŋke n'wvum, noo mwɛɛm mvù nu lɛŋ. Ben ekpwawcì mwɛɛm ɛ ɛ̀ nu mvù yuule bô mwɛɛm mvù bonyii ké no kooŋke noo mwɛɛm mvù sem nulo eta wee dvú. Ɛ́ mwɛɛm nu dvú mvù looci jee, ɛ́ mwɛɛm nu dvú mvù ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ bonyii ebɛnsee, ɛ́ ben no kpwawcì ɛ ɛ̀ nu ɛkumɛ mvumwɛ.

Ben egeè mwɛɛm biì kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu n'yɛɛyi wvù me nto nyaɛ ɛ̂ ben e, kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu mwɛɛm mvù ben to yuuke lo ɛ̂ me, kɛnɛɛ ɛ̀ nu mvù ben to yɛne lo. Ben nu dioo gee no nɛn, ɛ́ Nyo' wvù gee ɛ mvuntelem mvu bonyii le nu nyɛkeey emum enu ben ɛ bó.
Ɛ Baul yuw njoŋ no bonyii bo Filibi duŋci shiee fô wvú le
Tata nu ɛ ge me ɛ no n'yuuke njoŋ baay no ben nu ɛ bvuu ɛ duŋcɛ shiee wene fô me le kɛ no ben to shee duŋci. Me ŋkee naa ntay lɛ ben se kɛŋke kɛ shiee fô me le, geenɛn tane ɛ ɛ̀ nu je.
Kɛ me njemyi nɛn lɛ me nse ntane fiɛɛ kɛ. Me nu ɛ n'yɛɛyi wase ɛ ŋkiɛɛ keenfiisene mwɛɛm mvunciim.

Me ŋkee no wee ké no nu seke wvú tane, ŋkee no wee ké no nu seke wvú kɛŋke baay. Me ɛ mum ɛ n'yɛɛyi fifin ɛ ŋkiɛɛ no ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ me enu sekecii yî mwɛɛm e mvunciim kɛnɛɛ me nu ɛ ndie, kɛnɛɛ me mbaa endie, kɛnɛɛ me ŋkɛŋke baay kɛnɛɛ me ntane lo.
Me ŋkee keeŋge mwɛɛm mvun mvunciim nɛn, ɛ ɛ̀ nu bô mvuŋgay mvù Klistu nyaa ɛ̂ me le.
Geenɛn, no me ncim ŋgayte nɛn, ben nu ɛ ge naa ntay keefi me yî kefew ke ŋgɛw wɛm e kin e.

Ben bonyii bo Filibi kee lo lɛ ɛ̀ to nu seke me nto nɛn'yɛɛ woŋ wene le Masedonia no me nto ŋkɛwɛɛ keenfewci saaka wvù jee wvun ɛ̂ ben, kɛ kentaashɛ ke bonyii bo mbee le kemew to nu ɛ taashɛ bee bó keetasene can kɛ. Ɛ̀ to mɛy kɛ ben.
Ɛ̀ to nu naa seke me nto nu Tɛsalonika,
ɛ ben ciinse nfi ɛ̂ me, bvuu ciinse.
Kɛ me njemyi nɛn lɛ me ntaale lɛ ben eciinseè mwɛɛm ɛ̂ me kɛ. Me ntaale baay ɛ ɛ̀ nu mmawcɛ wvù Nyo' nu ke enya ɛ̂ ben yî fiɛɛ fì ben gee fô me le.

Ben to nu ɛ tum Ɛbaflodaytus bô nnya ɛ wvú to nya ɛ̂ me. Me ɛ no nu keseen n'yaa mbvuu ntane fiɛɛ kɛ. Me nto nu ɛ nfiisɛn nnya yidvu yicii, n'yɛn ɛ yí duule fele lo no me nshieele. Nnya yin nu ncese ɛ ben ɛ ge fô Nyo' le, ɛ wvú ɛ fiisɛn, yí ɛ no samte shfuuŋkene ɛ wvú kooŋke.
Nyo' wɛm wvù me mbunlee kɛŋke ntfu bvukukɛ bvucii bvù beene shieele, ɛ wvú nu ke enya ɛ̂ ben fiɛɛ ficii fì ben shieele, njefo beene nu bonyii bo Klistu Jisos e.
Mbense enù fô Nyo' Icee wesebeene wvun e sekecii sɛ ŋka. Fí enù nonɛn.
Ŋgayma
Ben egay bonyii bocii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Klistu Jisos e enya ɛ̂ me. Boom bo bwee wesebeene le bò nu bee bó fɛn gayte tɛn ben e.
Ɛ bonyii bocii bò ɛ̀ nu bo Nyo' le jan gayte ben e, ɛfey mvunciim bò nu ɛ̂ ntow Kaysa le fɛn.
Tata Jisos Klistu ebuw ben bô kembonɛn kew ɛ́ kí efici biyoy binɛn. Fí enù nonɛn.

footnotes.text: Tɛsalonika jan to nu kelaante woŋ wvù Masedonia le.
